expected: तत्रासूत च सा काले कुमारं कान्तदर्शनम्
brief: A mountain cave whose walls are carved with lines of script, lit by small lamps; four alcoves in the far wall, three dark and one glowing; a small amber spirit with cupped hands sitting in the first alcove; Dādī and Śuka at the front; at the cave mouth behind, a tall figure in a dark coat in silhouette.
An old woman in a cream cotton sari sits on a low stool reading a palm leaf aloud under a banyan tree; a green parrot on a branch above her listens with its head tilted; warm morning light.

The mother standing at the door of the small house at night with her hand on her small son's shoulder, looking up at the night sky where faint golden lines of script and a soft glow gather above the roof; the two scholars at her feet looking up in wonder; the boy listening with his head tilted.

A courtyard in Pāṭaliputra at dusk: two scholars facing each other, one older and assured, one thin and pale; a ring of silent listeners; above, a dark sky with a great shape of cloud and the faint outline of an ascetic with a crescent moon raising a hand; an unrolled palm-leaf manuscript on the ground between the two debaters.
